children: Wall Street futures rose on Friday as oil prices eased, while investors awaited the consumer inflation report for signs of a positive end to a difficult week.
At 4 pm IST, Nasdaq 100 futures rose 0.65 per cent, while S&P 500 futures advanced 0.57 per cent. Dow futures were up 0.56 per cent.

The rise in futures came after Brent crude touched a four-month high of USD 109.97 a barrel on Friday following a 6 per cent jump a day earlier. However, it soon came under selling pressure and was last down nearly 2 per cent at USD 105.90 a barrel. It was still set for a weekly gain of about 10 per cent.
Brent crude futures slipped more than 3 per cent but remained above USD 104 a barrel. West Texas Intermediate crude futures fell 2.6 per cent but stayed close to the USD 100-a-barrel mark.
Meanwhile, the yield on the 10-year US Treasury note dipped 0.16 basis points but remained at 4.9424 per cent, its highest level since 2023. High Treasury yields reduce the appeal of stocks.

title: Wall Street futures rise up to 0.6% as crude oil prices ease; CPI data awaited
